findings.title: Contradictory measurements
findings.text: This PR introduces three different figures for the same `--fast` measurement: this usage comment says "85s -> ~60s", the external-corpora comment a few lines later repeats "~19s of an 85s run", while AGENTS.md and the PR description state "a warm full run is 59s and a fast one 25s". A reader who quotes the gate's timing (which this repository treats as evidence, not decoration) gets two mutually exclusive answers. The likely cause is that the 85s/~60s pair predates the final measurement and was not updated; if so, the script comments should be aligned to 59s/25s (or both numbers should be stated with their provenance: cold vs warm). This is a documentation accuracy issue only; the flag behaves correctly.
